item.title: Needed 1+1, Built a Functional Programming Language
item.description: graphLang I was given a pretty straightforward data structures problem of convert an arithmetic expression into a binary tree. Naturally, instead of stopping there, I decided to build an evaluator for it. Then I had a thought. What if the evaluator didn’t actually need to know what the operations were? A few days later I implemented closures, a garbage collector, and a custom memory allocator in C. I had started with 1 + 1.
